pages.title: Store and Lift
pages.text: Place an Aura Node and Burning Pump at equal height, linked. A White Crystal adds 1,000 White Aura when used on either; dropping it within range also works. Drop coal near the pump; unpowered, it sends Aura upward.

pages.title: Follow the Fall
pages.text: Route Aura from a higher network block down to a lower one. Supported colors generate stored power at the receiving block as they fall. Network links follow clear cardinal lines to the first network block, up to 15 blocks away.

pages.title: Power a Consumer
pages.text: Place a consumer beside a network block that stores falling power; it draws from that pool to work. Drop a smeltable item near a Smelter. Colored Aura storage and stored power are separate pools. See $(l:aura:pumps_control)Pumps and Control$(/l) and $(l:aura:consumers_vortex)Consumers and Vortex$(/l).
